headline: Mooring County Churn Deepens as Weathered Expanse Reignites
war_summary: Mooring County has plunged into even fiercer upheaval over the early morning hours, recording ten strategic base transitions in the past two hours alone as both armies trade blow for blow across The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast under accelerating casualty rates. To the east, Weathered Expanse has reignited following a brief nocturnal lull, logging four fresh base changes and rising casualty rates centered on the contested approaches of Crow's Nest and Wightwalk. Meanwhile, Callum's Cape continues to endure relentless attritional slaughter with nearly two thousand combined casualties an hour, though territorial lines have temporarily locked into place with no base captures reported over the last six hours. Elsewhere along the front, the fighting has largely subsided into quiet positional vigilance; Linn of Mercy remains completely stalled following its earlier skirmishes at Outwich Ranch, while Marban Hollow, Stonecradle, and Stlican Shelf report negligible tactical movement. The war's decisive momentum remains tightly concentrated along the fractured highlands of Mooring County and the renewed clashes across Weathered Expanse.
